findings.claim: 政府收緊醫療／健康 takaful 規範（2026 年 7 月）：營運商不得單方面取消保單，亦不得僅因過往理賠或投保後健康變化而終止或拒絕續保；屬全產業規則，非針對 STMK。as_of 為月份推定（2026-07）。
findings.source: The Vibes: govt tightens insurance rules to protect policyholders from arbitrary cancellations and claim disputes
findings.excerpt: Operators cannot unilaterally cancel policies, and cannot terminate or refuse renewal solely because of past claims or changes in health after coverage has begun.

findings.claim: 馬來西亞下議院通過 Competition (Amendment) Bill 2026，強化 MyCC 對反競爭行為與濫用市場支配地位的執法；搜尋未見針對 takaful／保險業或 STMK 的調查。as_of 為推定（2026 年中）。
findings.source: The Sun Malaysia: Malaysia passes competition law amendments
findings.excerpt: The Dewan Rakyat today passed the Competition (Amendment) Bill 2026 with amendments at the committee stage.

regulatory_antitrust.note: 三次搜尋均未見 STMK 專屬反壟斷調查或 MyCC 案件；STMK 為最大家庭 takaful 營運商，但無拆分／壟斷報導。兩條 as_of 為由摘要月份推定，非精確日期。
